messages.text: Will a power spike fry the whole miner?

Great question — and it's one of the real design wins on the Rev 6.1.

**The onboard F1 fuse takes the hit, not your miner.**

- There's a small automotive-style blade fuse (**F1**) sitting right on the board, next to the yellow XT30 power input.
- If a spike comes through, **F1 blows first** — sacrificing itself to protect everything behind it.
- Cheaper miners skip this entirely. A spike there goes straight into the electronics and can kill the whole board.

**Here it costs you a fuse, not a miner.** Plug in a new fuse blade (cents at any auto parts store) and you're back running.
